capabilities.description: Dev-only agent bridge. Inlined here rather than dropped in capabilities/, which the build script scans whole — a file in there would demand the plugin from every release build too. withGlobalTauri above belongs to the same setup: the bridge returns every execute_js result through window.__TAURI__.core.invoke, and without it the plugin logs '__TAURI__ not available' and every webview_* tool times out after 2s. No comment key here — the config schema rejects unknown properties, '//' included.
